title: Regression-adjusted Monte Carlo Estimators for Shapley Values and Probabilistic Values
abstract: arXiv:2506.11849v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With origins in game theory, probabilistic values like Shapley values, Banzhaf values, and semi-values have emerged as a central tool in explainable AI. They are used for feature attribution, data attribution, data valuation, and more. Since exact computation can require exponential time, research has focused on efficient approximation methods using two techniques: Monte Carlo sampling and linear regression formulations. In this work, we present a new way of combining both of these techniques. Our approach is more flexible than prior algorithms, allowing for linear regression to be replaced with any function family whose probabilistic values can be computed efficiently. This allows us to harness the accuracy of tree-based models like XGBoost; with cross-fitting, the method also produces unbiased estimates. translated_title: 针对Shapley值与概率值的回归调整蒙特卡洛估计器
translated_abstract: 源于博弈论的概率值（如Shapley值、Banzhaf值和半值）已成为可解释人工智能领域的核心工具，被广泛应用于特征归因、数据归因、数据估值等任务。由于精确计算可能需要指数级时间，研究工作一直聚焦于两类高效近似技术：蒙特卡洛采样和线性回归建模。在本工作中，我们提出了一种将这两种技术相结合的新方法。与以往的算法相比，我们的方法更加灵活，允许将线性回归替换为任何其概率值可以被高效计算的函数族。这使得我们能够利用XGBoost等基于树的模型的准确性；通过交叉拟合，该方法还能产生无偏估计。在八个数据集上的实验表明，我们的方法在估计概率值方面达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: 本文提出一种将蒙特卡洛采样与回归调整相结合的新方法来估计Shapley值等概率值，允许用任意可高效计算概率值的函数族（如XGBoost）替代线性回归，并通过交叉拟合实现无偏且性能领先的概率值估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel regression-adjusted Monte Carlo framework for estimating Shapley values and probabilistic values, which flexibly replaces linear regression with any function family whose probabilistic values can be computed efficiently (e.g., XGBoost), achieving unbiased and state-of-the-art estimates through cross-fitting.
